p4_prediction.assumptions: same structured 3x10x4 hex topology, first-kind tensor-product Nedelec degree4, fully independent double-Floquet constraints, 836 unchanged auxiliary modes
p4_prediction.reservation_formula: 4*n^2*16 bytes plus current RSS plus independent512MiB margin; conservative admission estimate, NOT measured factor memory
p4_prediction.conclusion: Mass/direct/local reservations already exceed the 2GiB local and6GiB system boundary before existing RSS; no p4 admission under unchanged estimate. This does not establish actual p4 infeasibility.

missing_or_scope_traps: Global and local matrix NNZ absent in JSON; null means unrecorded, never zero. Factor NNZ is L.nnz+U.nnz, not bytes and not full-matrix NNZ.
All matrix assembly call counts, mass factor isolated timing and output isolated timing are unrecorded. Local assembly group includes maps/forms/commutators and checks, not one matrix-only timer.
actual_solve_counts count PC calls only; local residual-check solves and mass reconstruction check are extra.
Cold/warm cache identity cannot be established from these JSON files alone: unique case path is not proof of empty initial cache; no hit/miss counters.
N2 has no local PML and solves whole FE domain with exact original endpoint DtN; it is correctness anchor, not a distributed memory saving.
N4 largest local free factor has4080 rows, exceeding global independent FE3120 because fixed local PML adds cells. Three factors plus global mass factor remain resident.
These pilot processes retain the global assembled FE+aux system for true residual and reference comparison, plus global mass factor; results do not establish matrix-free target-scale memory saving.
N4 x0 total-field E error4.19e-5 hides4.45% scattered-field error because analytic background dominates; original residual0.11157 fails.
Physical direct and candidates have absolute energy defect~0.00470279 despite tiny candidate-reference differences. All power/H diagnostics remain unqualified for full physical accuracy.
Manufactured run power failure is preserved but is not physical scattering failure: artificial volume/aux source differs from illumination.
Sampling at0.1s is not continuous peak memory, and 4n²16 is a planning gate not measured factor memory.
